about_title: Bending and tube machines for the fabrication shop
about_text: NovoTech's value line is our own brand: machines built in China to our specification by a maker that exports metalworking machinery to more than 70 countries, inspected before they ship and sold under NovoTech's name with a CSA-approved panel on every 3-phase machine, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada.

Machines that bend and shape bar, sections, plate and tube: profile and ring benders that roll angle, flat bar and tube into rings, plate rolls and slip rolls, hydraulic and manual tube and pipe benders, tube notchers and belt tube-end grinders that cope tube for welding, and hydraulic horizontal benders for flat bar.
